name: JioHotstar
description: JioHotstar is an Indian subscription video-on-demand streaming platform operated by JioStar, a joint venture between Reliance Industries and The Walt Disney Company.

stock.note: Reflects parent company entities (Reliance Industries RELIANCE.NS and The Walt Disney Company DIS), not this brand specifically.

marketing_spend.derivation: Modeled using OTT industry standard marketing-to-content investment ratio (~15-25%) against JioHotstar's annual content commitments (including its ₹800 crore annual budget for South Indian content) and user acquisition spend for its 50M+ subscriber base.

business_updates.headline: Reliance-Disney's JioHotstar commits $444 million (₹40 billion) over 5 years for South Indian content
Reliance and Disney complete $8.5 billion transaction to form JioStar media joint venture
